description: Corridor Crew is a channel where professional VFX artists and filmmakers analyze, critique, and react to visual effects in movies, TV shows, and viral videos. Their most popular series, VFX Artists React, features the crew sitting on a couch breaking down both the best and worst CGI and practical effects, explaining how shots were achieved and why some hold up while others fail. Beyond reactions, the channel also includes behind-the-scenes looks at their own filmmaking process, VFX tutorials, and experiments with new technology like AI-generated video.
